title: AI cracked the Navier–Stokes challenge. What does that mean for physics?
title_zh: 人工智能破解了纳维-斯托克斯挑战。这对物理学意味着什么？
abstract: Physicists and mathematicians are going beyond the classic equations of fluid dynamics to understand turbulence — often with the help of artificial intelligence.
abstract_zh: 物理学家和数学家正在超越经典流体动力学方程，以理解湍流——通常借助人工智能的帮助。
